ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the B3-3 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 5-J in the area bound by:


       The alley next north of and parallel to West Armitage Avenue; a line 74.63
       feet west of and parallel to North St. Louis Avenue; West Armitage Avenue;
       and a line 99.63 feet west of and parallel to North St. Louis Avenue;


To those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.


SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Common Address of Property:                  3508 West Armitage Avenue
